episodes.title: A — WITH room tone + breath
episodes.synopsis: Identical picture and narration. The gaps carry pink room tone at -56 dBFS, and sentence-rank pauses carry an inhale. 0.8% of samples are true digital zero.

episodes.title: B — WITHOUT (digital silence)
episodes.synopsis: Identical picture and narration. Every gap is ffmpeg anullsrc: mathematical zeros. 17.3% of samples are true digital zero. This is what shipped before.
